l-m-m1-b04-28.s.s1.r.a: Oku bubungakanani be-engile enye yangaphandle. Kwi-engile yangaphakathi, thabatha i-engile yangaphandle kwi-180°.
l-m-m1-b04-28.s.s1.r.b: Le yi-engile enye yangaphakathi yesikwere. Ngamacala angama-20, inkulu kakhulu.
l-m-m1-b04-28.s.s1.r.d: 360° isixa sii-engile zangaphandle. I-engile enye yangaphakathi incinci kune-180°.
l-m-m1-b04-28.s.s1.explain: I-engile enye yangaphandle yi-360°÷20=18°, kwaye i-engile yangaphakathi yi-180°−18°=162°. Ngoko ingamalunga nama-160°.

l-m-m1-b04-29.material: Konxantathu ABC onee-AB=AC ne-∠A=50°, ∠B yafunyanwa ngolu hlobo. ① Ekubeni AB=AC, ∠B=∠C ② Isixa sii-engile zangaphakathi singama-180° ③ ∠B+∠C=180°−50°=130° ④ ∠B=130°
l-m-m1-b04-29.s.s1.r.a: Ukuba AB=AC, ii-engile zesiseko ∠B kunye ne-∠C ziyalingana, ngoko ichanekile.

l-m-m1-b04-29.s.s2.model.0: Isixa se-∠B kunye ne-∠C singama-130°, kodwa i-∠B yodwa yathiwa ngama-130°, ngoko ④ iphosakele. Ukwahlula nge-2 kunika ama-65°.
l-m-m1-b04-29.s.s2.model.1: ∠B=∠C, ngoko ama-130° kufuneka ahlulwe abe mabini, yiyo loo nto ∠B=65° ichanekile.

l-m-m1-b0s4-09.s.s1.r.c: Lo mgca ulandela nje isiphumo sika-②, ngoko ayiyo apho impazamo yokuqala ikhoyo.
